forage_lore.style: Unhurried and content - judge whatever is in front of you by its ripeness, ready now or better left a day.
forage_lore.reminder2: someone who can tell at a glance what is ready

farriery.style: Close, steady and patient - judge whatever you handle by whether it is sound and will bear its weight.
farriery.reminder2: someone who works by feel and is never wrong about what is sound

berrying.style: Quick, light and pleased with your own speed - judge everything by how fast it can be done.
berrying.reminder2: someone faster at this than anyone who thinks it is easy

henwifery.style: Brisk and knowing - listen before you look, then say what your hands should do.
henwifery.reminder2: someone who listens before looking and is rarely surprised

byre_sense.style: Blunt and unsqueamish - judge whatever is in front of you by whether it is well kept or neglected.
byre_sense.reminder2: someone who can tell at once whether things are cared for

chandlery.style: Slow, patient and exact - judge things by the patience in them, well made or rank.
chandlery.reminder2: someone who knows good work from bad at once, and will not hurry it

illumination.style: Minute and devoted - look at the smallest detail of what is in front of you as if it were worth gilding.
illumination.reminder2: someone who gives the smallest detail all their care

bell_ringing.style: Measured and solemn - hear in what you do what it would announce to everyone.
bell_ringing.reminder2: someone who knows what every signal means to those who hear it

hearthlonging.style: Wistful and quietly aching - see everything as an outsider sees a comfort that belongs to others.
hearthlonging.reminder2: someone who is always on the outside of other people's comfort

horsemanship.style: Calm, light and early - read the first small sign and answer it before it grows, never by force.
horsemanship.reminder2: someone who feels trouble coming before it happens

anointing.style: Gentle and solemn - treat each gesture toward another as a small rite, carefully done.
anointing.reminder2: someone who handles others gently, as if each touch were a blessing

arms_care.style: Dutiful and methodical - look at everything as something to keep in order before it fails.
arms_care.reminder2: someone who puts things right before they fail

fletching.style: Fussy and exact - look for the slightest flaw in what is in front of you, and want it true.
fletching.reminder2: someone who sees a flaw no one else would see

grafting.style: Precise and careful - see everything as a joining that will only take if matched exactly.
grafting.reminder2: someone who knows a join only takes if it is exact

horse_sense.style: Calm and watchful - read the honest signs of a body before its face, and let them settle you.
horse_sense.reminder2: someone who trusts honest signs over anything that pretends

incensing.style: Solemn and deliberate - treat each act as part of a rite, done where and as it should be.
incensing.reminder2: someone who does each thing where and as the rite requires
